title: J.J. McCarthy knows he can be better despite being more than enough for Giants so far

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: J.J. McCarthy knows he can be better despite being more than enough for Giants so far
sources.description: McCarthy has averaged 211.2 passing yards and 22.5 rushing yards in four starts, with two touchdowns, one interception and a 60.3 completion percentage.
